sources: Walter Electronic TG series thermal cutoff specification (MS-DE-031-60, 7th edition), LCSC's copy https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/a2cd2ee1b327c5e49abcbab741f9618a.pdf?productCode=C435442, read 2026-11-03
3. ratings: 15 A, 250 V AC; type table: TG113 rated functioning temperature 113 °C (cut-off 108 ± 2 °C, holding 81 °C, maximum 200 °C); the series' lowest are TG66 (66 °C) and TG77 (77 °C)

pins: the two axial leads, 1 and 2

open: the README's bill of materials names an SF70E (SEFUSE, 73 °C) thermal fuse, which LCSC does not sell; the Walter TG113 (113 °C) stands in – the trip temperature is in no check of edakit
